@dev Contract module that allows children to implement role-based access
 control mechanisms. This is a lightweight version that doesn't allow enumerating role
 members except through off-chain means by accessing the contract event logs. Some
 applications may benefit from on-chain enumerability, for those cases see
 {AccessControlEnumerable}.
 Roles are referred to by their `bytes32` identifier. These should be exposed
 in the external API and be unique. The best way to achieve this is by
 using `public constant` hash digests:
 ```
 bytes32 public constant MY_ROLE = keccak256("MY_ROLE");
 ```
 Roles can be used to represent a set of permissions. To restrict access to a
 function call, use {hasRole}:
 ```
 function foo() public {
     require(hasRole(MY_ROLE, msg.sender));
     ...
 }
 ```
 Roles can be granted and revoked dynamically via the {grantRole} and
 {revokeRole} functions. Each role has an associated admin role, and only
 accounts that have a role's admin role can call {grantRole} and {revokeRole}.
 By default, the admin role for all roles is `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, which means
 that only accounts with this role will be able to grant or revoke other
 roles. More complex role relationships can be created by using
 {_setRoleAdmin}.
 WARNING: The `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is also its own admin: it has permission to
 grant and revoke this role. Extra precautions should be taken to secure
 accounts that have been granted it.

@dev Returns true if `account` is a contract.
 [IMPORTANT]
 ====
 It is unsafe to assume that an address for which this function returns
 false is an externally-owned account (EOA) and not a contract.
 Among others, `isContract` will return false for the following
 types of addresses:
  - an externally-owned account
  - a contract in construction
  - an address where a contract will be created
  - an address where a contract lived, but was destroyed
 ====
 [IMPORTANT]
 ====
 You shouldn't rely on `isContract` to protect against flash loan attacks!
 Preventing calls from contracts is highly discouraged. It breaks composability, breaks support for smart wallets
 like Gnosis Safe, and does not provide security since it can be circumvented by calling from a contract
 constructor.
 ====

@dev Replacement for Solidity's `transfer`: sends `amount` wei to
 `recipient`, forwarding all available gas and reverting on errors.
 https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1884[EIP1884] increases the gas cost
 of certain opcodes, possibly making contracts go over the 2300 gas limit
 imposed by `transfer`, making them unable to receive funds via
 `transfer`. {sendValue} removes this limitation.
 https://diligence.consensys.net/posts/2019/09/stop-using-soliditys-transfer-now/[Learn more].
 IMPORTANT: because control is transferred to `recipient`, care must be
 taken to not create reentrancy vulnerabilities. Consider using
 {ReentrancyGuard} or the
 https://solidity.readthedocs.io/en/v0.5.11/security-considerations.html#use-the-checks-effects-interactions-pattern[checks-effects-interactions pattern].

@dev Performs a Solidity function call using a low level `call`. A
 plain `call` is an unsafe replacement for a function call: use this
 function instead.
 If `target` reverts with a revert reason, it is bubbled up by this
 function (like regular Solidity function calls).
 Returns the raw returned data. To convert to the expected return value,
 use https://solidity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/units-and-global-variables.html?highlight=abi.decode#abi-encoding-and-decoding-functions[`abi.decode`].
 Requirements:
 - `target` must be a contract.
 - calling `target` with `data` must not revert.
 _Available since v3.1._

By default, the owner account will be the one that deploys the contract. This can later be changed with {transferOwnership}. This module is used through inheritance. It will make available the modifier `onlyOwner`, which can be applied to your functions to restrict their use to the owner.

NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.details: Contract module that helps prevent reentrant calls to a function. Inheriting from `ReentrancyGuard` will make the {nonReentrant} modifier available, which can be applied to functions to make sure there are no nested (reentrant) calls to them. Note that because there is a single `nonReentrant` guard, functions marked as `nonReentrant` may not call one another. This can be worked around by making those functions `private`, and then adding `external` `nonReentrant` entry points to them. TIP: If you would like to learn more about reentrancy and alternative ways to protect against it, check out our blog post https://blog.openzeppelin.com/reentrancy-after-istanbul/[Reentrancy After Istanbul].

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

/**
 * @dev Interface of the ERC20 Permit extension allowing approvals to be made via signatures, as defined in
 * https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2612[EIP-2612].
 *
 * Adds the {permit} method, which can be used to change an account's ERC20 allowance (see {IERC20-allowance}) by
 * presenting a message signed by the account. By not relying on {IERC20-approve}, the token holder account doesn't
 * need to send a transaction, and thus is not required to hold Ether at all.
 */
interface IERC20Permit {
    /**
     * @dev Sets `value` as the allowance of `spender` over ``owner``'s tokens,
     * given ``owner``'s signed approval.
     *
     * IMPORTANT: The same issues {IERC20-approve} has related to transaction
     * ordering also apply here.
     *
     * Emits an {Approval} event.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - `spender` cannot be the zero address.
     * - `deadline` must be a timestamp in the future.
     * - `v`, `r` and `s` must be a valid `secp256k1` signature from `owner`
     * over the EIP712-formatted function arguments.
     * - the signature must use ``owner``'s current nonce (see {nonces}).
     *
     * For more information on the signature format, see the
     * https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2612#specification[relevant EIP
     * section].
     */
    function permit(
        address owner,
        address spender,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 deadline,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) external;

    /**
     * @dev Returns the current nonce for `owner`. This value must be
     * included whenever a signature is generated for {permit}.
     *
     * Every successful call to {permit} increases ``owner``'s nonce by one. This
     * prevents a signature from being used multiple times.
     */
    function nonces(address owner) external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the domain separator used in the encoding of the signature for {permit}, as defined by {EIP712}.
     */
    // solhint-disable-next-line func-name-mixedcase
    function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() external view returns (bytes32);
}

@dev Integrates with ReputationManager and LendingPool for reputation staking\r\n */\r\ncontract CoSigningManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    ReputationManager public immutable reputationManager;\r\n    LendingPool public immutable lendingPool;\r\n\r\n    bytes32 public constant LENDING_POOL_ROLE = keccak256(\"LENDING_POOL_ROLE\");\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextRequestId = 1;\r\n    uint256 public nextRecordId = 1;\r\n\r\n    // Storage\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CoSigningRequest) public coSigningRequests;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CoSigningRecord) public coSigningRecords;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public loanCoSigners; // loanId      => recordIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userRequests; // borrower    => requestIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userCoSignings; // coSigner    => recordIds[]\r\n    mapping(uint256 => address) public offerCoSigner;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public offerToCoSignRecord;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => bool) public offerHasActiveRequest;\r\n\r\n    // \u2190 NEW: index accepted records by their originating loan offer so that\r\n    //   LendingPool.cancelLoanOffer can find and reverse them.\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public offerToRecords; // loanOfferId => recordIds[]\r\n\r\n    // Co-signing limits\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_COSIGNER_REPUTATION = 50; //to be changed back to 200\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_BONUS_PERCENTAGE = 50;\r\n    uint256 public constant COOLDOWN_PERIOD = 30 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_COSIGNERS_PER_LOAN = 3;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningRequest {\r\n        uint256 requestId;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId;\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        uint256 createdAt;\r\n        string message;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningRecord {\r\n        uint256 recordId;\r\n        address coSigner;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId;\r\n        uint256 reputationStaked;\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided;\r\n        uint256 coSignTimestamp;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        bool loanCompleted;\r\n        bool borrowerDefaulted;\r\n        bool wasCancelled;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningRequestCreated(\r\n        uint256 indexed requestId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanOfferId,\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus,\r\n        string message\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningRequestCancelled(\r\n        uint256 indexed requestId,\r\n        address indexed borrower\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningCompleted(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningReleased(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        bool successfulRepayment\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSignerPenalized(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 penaltyAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSignerRewarded(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 rewardAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // \u2190 NEW\r\n    event CoSigningRecordCancelled(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InsufficientReputation();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__MaxCoSignersReached();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__CannotCoSignSelf();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InvalidBonus();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordAlreadyLinked();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__CoSignerCannotBeLender();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RequestAlreadyExists();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__AlreadyCoSigned();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(address _reputationManager, address _lendingPool) {\r\n        if (_reputationManager == address(0) || _lendingPool == address(0)) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        reputationManager = ReputationManager(_reputationManager);\r\n        lendingPool = LendingPool(_lendingPool);\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE, _lendingPool);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions - Request Management ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Create a co-signing request for a loan offer\r\n     * @param loanOfferId The ID of the loan offer\r\n     * @param requestedBonus Stored for display only \u2014 has no on-chain effect\r\n     * @param message Optional message to potential co-signers\r\n     * @return requestId The ID of the created request\r\n     */\r\n    function createCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId,\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus,\r\n        string calldata message\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 requestId) {\r\n        if (requestedBonus == 0) revert CoSigningManager__InvalidBonus();\r\n\r\n        LendingPool.LoanOffer memory offer = lendingPool.getLoanOffer(\r\n            loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n        if (offer.creator == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n\r\n        // Only the offer creator can request co-signing for their own offer\r\n        if (offer.creator != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n\r\n        // Block duplicate active requests for the same offer\r\n        if (offerHasActiveRequest[loanOfferId])\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RequestAlreadyExists();\r\n\r\n        // Block if already co-signed (accepted)\r\n        if (offerCoSigner[loanOfferId] != address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__AlreadyCoSigned();\r\n\r\n        requestId = nextRequestId++;\r\n\r\n        coSigningRequests[requestId] = CoSigningRequest({\r\n            requestId: requestId,\r\n            borrower: msg.sender,\r\n            loanOfferId: loanOfferId,\r\n            requestedBonus: requestedBonus,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            createdAt: block.timestamp,\r\n            message: message\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userRequests[msg.sender].push(requestId);\r\n        offerHasActiveRequest[loanOfferId] = true;\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningRequestCreated(\r\n            requestId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loanOfferId,\r\n            requestedBonus,\r\n            message\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return requestId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Cancel a co-signing REQUEST (before anyone has accepted it).\r\n     * @dev No reputation has been applied yet at this stage \u2014 no reversal needed.\r\n     *      Only the borrower who created the request can call this.\r\n     * @param requestId The ID of the request to cancel\r\n     */\r\n    function cancelCoSigningRequest(uint256 requestId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRequest storage request = coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n\r\n        if (request.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n        if (!request.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n        if (request.borrower != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n\r\n        request.isActive = false;\r\n        delete offerCoSigner[request.loanOfferId];\r\n        offerHasActiveRequest[request.loanOfferId] = false;\r\n        emit CoSigningRequestCancelled(requestId, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Accept a co-signing request and stake reputation\r\n     * @param requestId The ID of the request to accept\r\n     * @return recordId The ID of the co-signing record\r\n     */\r\n    function acceptCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 requestId\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 recordId) {\r\n        CoSigningRequest storage request = coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n\r\n        if (request.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n        if (!request.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n        if (msg.sender == request.borrower)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__CannotCoSignSelf();\r\n\r\n        uint256 coSignerReputation = reputationManager.getReputationScore(\r\n            msg.sender\r\n        );\r\n        if (coSignerReputation < MIN_COSIGNER_REPUTATION) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InsufficientReputation();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Actual bonus determined by ReputationManager \u2014 requestedBonus is ignored here\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided = reputationManager.addCoSigningBonus(\r\n            request.borrower,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            coSignerReputation,\r\n            request.loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        recordId = nextRecordId++;\r\n\r\n        coSigningRecords[recordId] = CoSigningRecord({\r\n            recordId: recordId,\r\n            coSigner: msg.sender,\r\n            borrower: request.borrower,\r\n            loanId: 0,\r\n            loanOfferId: request.loanOfferId,\r\n            reputationStaked: coSignerReputation,\r\n            bonusProvided: bonusProvided,\r\n            coSignTimestamp: block.timestamp,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            loanCompleted: false,\r\n            borrowerDefaulted: false,\r\n            wasCancelled: false\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userCoSignings[msg.sender].push(recordId);\r\n\r\n        //   look up this record by offer ID and reverse the bonus if needed.\r\n        offerToRecords[request.loanOfferId].push(recordId);\r\n\r\n        offerCoSigner[request.loanOfferId] = msg.sender;\r\n\r\n        offerToCoSignRecord[request.loanOfferId] = recordId;\r\n\r\n        // Deactivate the request \u2014 one co-signer per request\r\n        request.isActive = false;\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            request.borrower,\r\n            0,\r\n            bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return recordId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Cancel an active co-signing RECORD when the underlying loan offer\r\n     *         is cancelled by the borrower before a lender accepts it.\r\n     * @dev Reverses the reputation bonus given to the borrower and decrements\r\n     *      the co-signer's active count. Called by LendingPool (which holds\r\n     *      DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) or directly by the borrower.\r\n     * @param recordId The ID of the co-signing record to cancel\r\n     */\r\n    function cancelCoSigningRecord(uint256 recordId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n\r\n        // Only the borrower or LendingPool (admin) can cancel\r\n        if (\r\n            msg.sender != record.borrower &&\r\n            !hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender)\r\n        ) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        record.isActive = false;\r\n        record.loanCompleted = true;\r\n        record.wasCancelled = true;\r\n\r\n        // Reverse the reputation bonus given to the borrower\r\n        reputationManager.clearOfferCoSigningBonus(\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            record.loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Decrement the co-signer's active co-sign count\r\n        reputationManager.decrementActiveCoSigns(record.coSigner);\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningRecordCancelled(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower\r\n        );\r\n        emit CoSigningReleased(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            false\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Add co-signer to an active loan (called by borrower after loan is matched)\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the matched loan\r\n     * @param coSignRecordId The ID of the co-signing record\r\n     */\r\n    function addCoSignerToLoan(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 coSignRecordId\r\n    ) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[coSignRecordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n\r\n        LendingPool.Loan memory loan = lendingPool.getLoan(loanId);\r\n        if (loan.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n        if (loan.borrower != record.borrower)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n\r\n        if (loan.lender == record.coSigner)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__CoSignerCannotBeLender();\r\n\r\n        if (loanCoSigners[loanId].length >= MAX_COSIGNERS_PER_LOAN) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__MaxCoSignersReached();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        record.loanId = loanId;\r\n        loanCoSigners[loanId].push(coSignRecordId);\r\n\r\n        reputationManager.applyOfferCoSigningBonus(\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            record.loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            coSignRecordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            record.bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Release co-signing after loan completion\r\n     * @param recordId The ID of the co-signing );\r\n\r\n        if (successfulRepayment) {\r\n            reputationManager.rewardCoSigner(record.coSigner, record.borrower);\r\n            emit CoSignerRewarded(\r\n                recordId,\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                10\r\n            );\r\n        } else {\r\n            record.borrowerDefaulted = true;\r\n            reputationManager.penalizeCoSigner(\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                record.reputationStaked\r\n            );\r\n            emit CoSignerPenalized(\r\n                recordId,\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                record.reputationStaked / 3\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningReleased(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            successfulRepayment\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Link a co-signing record to a matched loan (called by LendingPool)\r\n     * @param recordId The co-signing record ID\r\n     * @param loanId The matched loan ID\r\n     */\r\n    function linkRecordToLoan(\r\n        uint256 recordId,\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = loanCoSigners[loanId].push(recordId);\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            record.bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ View Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all record IDs for a given loan offer.\r\n     * @dev borrower\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (coSignCount == 0) {\r\n            return baseBonus;\r\n        } else if (coSignCount == 1) {\r\n            return (baseBonus * 60) / 100;\r\n        } else     if (record.isActive) {\r\n                record.isActive = false;\r\n                reputationManager.decrementActiveCoSigns(record.coSigner);\r\n                emit CoSigningReleased(\r\n  uint256 activeCount = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < requestIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[requestIds[i]].isActive) activeCount++;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        CoSigningRequest[] memory activeRequests = new CoSigningRequest[](\r\n            activeCount\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < requestIds.length; i++) }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if diminishing returns apply for a pair\r\n     */\r\n    function hasDiminishingReturns(\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) totalCoSignings = recordIds.length;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CoSigningRecord memory record = coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]];\r\n            if defaultedCoSignings++;\r\n                } else if (!record.wasCancelled) {\r\n                    successfulCoSignings++;\r\n                }\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return (\r\n            totalCoSignings,\r\n            activeCoSignings,\r\n            successfulCoSignings,\r\n            defaultedCoSignings\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get     }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return openRequests;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all co-signing record IDs for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The loan ID\r\n     * @return Array of }\r\n\r\n    function isCoSignerForOffer(\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId,\r\n        address account\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        return offerCoSigner[loanOfferId] == SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\nimport \"./PriceOracle.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title CollateralManager\r\n * @notice Manages collateral deposits, withdrawals, and liquidations for lending platform\r\n * @dev Integrates with PriceOracle for real-time collateral valuation\r\n */\r\ncontract CollateralManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\r\n\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    bytes32 public constant LENDING_POOL_ROLE = keccak256(\"LENDING_POOL_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant LIQUIDATOR_ROLE = keccak256(\"LIQUIDATOR_ROLE\");\r\n\r\n    PriceOracle public immutable priceOracle;\r\n\r\n    // Collateral deposits\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CollateralDeposit) public deposits;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public loanToDepositIds; // loanId => depositIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userDepositIds; // user => depositIds[]\r\n\r\n    // Token information\r\n    mapping(address => TokenInfo) public supportedTokens;\r\n    mapping(address => uint8) public tokenDecimals;\r\n    address[] public supportedTokenList;\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextDepositId;\r\n\r\n    // Liquidation parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD = 11000; // 110% (in basis points)\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_COLLATERAL_RATIO = 12000; // 120% (in basis points)\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_BONUS = 500; // 5% bonus for liquidators\r\n    uint256 public constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000; // 100%\r\n\r\n    // Grace period before liquidation (to give borrower time to add collateral)\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_GRACE_PERIOD = 1 hours;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct CollateralDeposit {\r\n        uint256 depositId;\r\n        address depositor;\r\n        address tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount;\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        bool isLocked;\r\n        uint256 depositTimestamp;\r\n        uint256 lockedTimestamp;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct TokenInfo {\r\n        bool isSupported;\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount; // Max amount that can be deposited\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty; // Penalty on liquidation (basis points)\r\n        uint256 totalDeposited; // Total amount currently deposited\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct CollateralValue {\r\n        address tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount;\r\n        uint256 valueInUSD;\r\n        uint256 lastUpdated;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event CollateralDeposited(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        address indexed depositor,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralWithdrawn(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        address indexed depositor,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralLocked(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralLiquidated(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event TokenRemoved(address indexed token);\r\n\r\n    event TokenConfigUpdated(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n    error CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n    error CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n    error CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n    error CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n    error CollateralManager__DepositNotLocked();\r\n    error CollateralManager__UnauthorizedWithdrawal();\r\n    error CollateralManager__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n    error CollateralManager__CannotLiquidate();\r\n    error CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n    error CollateralManager__MaxDepositExceeded();\r\n    error CollateralManager__TransferFailed();\r\n    error CollateralManager__GracePeriodActive();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(address _priceOracle) {\r\n        if (_priceOracle == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n        priceOracle = PriceOracle(_priceOracle);\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(LIQUIDATOR_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n\r\n        nextDepositId = 1;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Add a supported collateral token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param decimals_ The token decimals\r\n     * @param maxDepositAmount Maximum deposit amount\r\n     * @param liquidationPenalty Liquidation penalty in basis points\r\n     */\r\n    function addSupportedToken(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint8 decimals_,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (token == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n        if (supportedTokens[token].isSupported)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n\r\n        // Verify token is supported by price oracle\r\n        if (!priceOracle.isSupportedToken(token)) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token] = TokenInfo({\r\n            isSupported: true,\r\n            maxDepositAmount: maxDepositAmount,\r\n            liquidationPenalty: liquidationPenalty,\r\n            totalDeposited: 0\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        tokenDecimals[token] = decimals_;\r\n        supportedTokenList.push(token);\r\n\r\n        emit TokenAdded(token, maxDepositAmount, liquidationPenalty);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Remove a supported token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     */\r\n    function removeSupportedToken(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[token].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Check no active deposits\r\n        if (supportedTokens[token].totalDeposited > 0) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].isSupported = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from list\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < supportedTokenList.length; i++) {\r\n            if (supportedTokenList[i] == token) {\r\n                supportedTokenList[i] = supportedTokenList[\r\n                    supportedTokenList.length - 1\r\n                ];\r\n                supportedTokenList.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit TokenRemoved(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update token configuration\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param maxDepositAmount New max deposit amount\r\n     * @param liquidationPenalty New liquidation penalty\r\n     */\r\n    function updateTokenConfig(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[token].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].maxDepositAmount = maxDepositAmount;\r\n        supportedTokens[token].liquidationPenalty = liquidationPenalty;\r\n\r\n        emit TokenConfigUpdated(token, maxDepositAmount, liquidationPenalty);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Deposit collateral for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param tokenAddress The address of the collateral address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 depositId) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[tokenAddress].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n        if (amount == 0) revert CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        TokenInfo storage tokenInfo = supportedTokens[tokenAddress];\r\n\r\n        // Check max deposit\r\n        if (amount > tokenInfo.maxDepositAmount) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__MaxDepositExceeded();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        depositId = nextDepositId++;\r\n\r\n        deposits[depositId] = CollateralDeposit({\r\n            depositId: depositId,\r\n            depositor: msg.sender,\r\n            tokenAddress: tokenAddress,\r\n            amount: amount,\r\n            loanId: loanId,\r\n            isLocked: false,\r\n            depositTimestamp: block.timestamp,\r\n            lockedTimestamp: 0\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        loanToDepositIds[loanId].push(depositId);\r\n        userDepositIds[msg.sender].push(depositId);\r\n\r\n        tokenInfo.totalDeposited += amount;\r\n\r\n        // Transfer tokens from user to this contract\r\n        IERC20(tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            address(this),\r\n            amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralDeposited(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            tokenAddress,\r\n            amount,\r\n            block.timestamp\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return depositId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Withdraw unlocked collateral\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to withdraw\r\n     */\r\n    function withdrawCollateral(uint256 depositId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (deposit.depositor != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__UnauthorizedWithdrawal();\r\n        if (deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n\r\n        address token = deposit.tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount = deposit.amount;\r\n        address depositor = deposit.depositor;\r\n\r\n        // Update state\r\n        supportedTokens[token].totalDeposited -= amount;\r\n        delete deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        // Transfer tokens back to user\r\n        IERC20(token).safeTransfer(depositor, amount);\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralWithdrawn(depositId, depositor, token, amount);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Lock collateral when loan becomes active (called by LendingPool)\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to lock\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     */\r\n    function lockCollateral(\r\n        uint256 depositId,\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n        if (deposit.loanId != loanId) revert CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        deposit.isLocked = true;\r\n        deposit.lockedTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralLocked(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n            deposit.amount,\r\n            block.timestamp\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Unlock collateral after successful repayment (called by LendingPool)\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to unlock\r\n     */\r\n    function unlockCollateral(\r\n        uint256 depositId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (!deposit.isLocked) revert deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n            deposit.amount\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Liquidate collateral for a defaulted loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the defaulted );\r\n\r\n            // Apply liquidation penalty\r\n            uint256 penalty = supportedTokens[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n                .liquidationPenalty;\r\n            uint256         uint256 value = priceOracle.getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n                    deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n                    deposit.amount,\r\n                    tokenDecimals[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n                );\r\n                totalValue += value;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return totalValue;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * CollateralDeposit[] memory userDeposits = new CollateralDeposit[](\r\n            depositIds.length\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            userDeposits[i] = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return userDeposits;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if collateral is sufficient for a loan\r\n     * @param }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0xab99fbb0548117617b48c5e270ae9e97968940342d5fba3c9a16cb97b0b8dacc","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/LendingPool.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\r\n\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    ReputationManager public immutable reputationManager;\r\n    CollateralManager public immutable    // Platform fee (in basis points)\r\n    uint256 public platformFeeRate = 100; // 1%\r\n    uint256 public constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PLATFORM_FEE = 500; // BORROW_REQUEST\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct LoanTerms {\r\n        address tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 principalAmount;\r\n        uint256 }\r\n\r\n    struct LoanOffer {\r\n        uint256 offerId;\r\n        LoanType offerType;\r\n        address creator;\r\n        LoanTerms terms;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        uint256      });\r\n\r\n        userOffers[msg.sender].push(offerId);\r\n\r\n        if (offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            activeLenderOffers.push(offerId);\r\n\r\n            // Lender locks funds upfront\r\n            IERC20(terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n                msg.sender,\r\n                address(this),\r\n                terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        } else {\r\n            activeBorrowerRequests.push(offerId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanOfferCreated(\r\n            offerId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            offerType,\r\n            terms.principalAmount,\r\n            terms.interestRate,\r\n            terms.duration\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return offerId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice revert LendingPool__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n\r\n        offer.isActive = false;\r\n\r\n        if (address(coSigningManager) != address(0)) {\r\n            try\r\n                coSigningManager.handleOfferCancelled(offerId, offer.creator)\r\n            {} catch {}\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Remove from active lists\r\n        if (offer.offerType == }\r\n\r\n        // Return locked funds to lender\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n                msg.sender,\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // //   (a) the reputation bonus given to the borrower is reversed, and\r\n        // //   (b) the co-signer's active count is decremented correctly.\r\n        // if (address(coSigningManager) != address(0)) {\r\n        //     uint256[] memory recordIds = CoSigningManager.CoSigningRecord\r\n        //             memory record = coSigningManager.getCoSigningRecord(\r\n        //                 recordIds[i]\r\n        //             );\r\n        //        //         }\r\n        //     }\r\n        // }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanOfferCancelled(offerId, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Accept a loan offer and create an active   address lender;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            // Lender created the offer \u2014 msg.sender is the borrower\r\n            lender = offer.creator;\r\n            borrower = msg.sender;\r\n\r\n            // Enforce minimum reputation for borrower\r\n            if (\r\n                !reputationManager.meetsReputationRequirement(\r\n                    borrower,\r\n                    offer.terms.minReputation\r\n                )\r\n            ) {\r\n                revert LendingPool__InsufficientReputation();\r\n            }\r\n        } else {\r\n            // Borrower created the request \u2014 msg.sender is the lender\r\n            lender = msg.sender;\r\n IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n                lender,\r\n                address(this),\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Verify and lock collateral\r\n        if (offer.terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n            bool sufficient = collateralManager.isCollateralSufficient(\r\n                collateralDepositId,\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount,\r\n                offer.terms.collateralRatio\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            if (!sufficient) revert amountRepaid: 0,\r\n            collateralDepositId: collateralDepositId,\r\n            hasCoSigner: false,\r\n            coSigner: address(0)\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userLoans[lender].push(loanId);\r\n        userLoans[borrower].push(loanId);\r\n\r\n        if (address(coSigningManager) != address(0)) {\r\n            uint256[] memory recordIds = CoSigningManager.CoSigningRecord\r\n                    memory record = coSigningManager.getCoSigningRecord(\r\n                        recordIds[i]\r\n                    );\r\n\r\n                if           break; // Only one co-signer per loan for now\r\n                }\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Deactivate offer and remove from active list\r\n        offer.isActive =
